text:
laura: Hey team — customer on Vercel edge runtime reporting that TypeScript SDK streaming is aborting early and the client library retries are spawning duplicate SSE connections. They see duplicate tokens billed. Repro steps below, and we've got logs/error.
laura: Repro (minimal):
laura: ```ts
laura: import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
laura: const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
laura: const res = await client.stream.chat.create({
laura:   model: 'open-lite',
laura:   messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'stream test' }]
laura: });
laura: const reader = res.body.getReader();
laura: while(true){ const {done, value} = await reader.read(); if(done) break; console.log(new TextDecoder().decode(value)); }
laura: ```
laura: Behavior: works for ~3-7s then `ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE` in the edge function, the SDK auto-retries, and we can see two SSE subscriptions hitting the backend. Customer reports token/usage double-counting. App is on Vercel Edge (edge runtime), bundler is Vite. SDK version reported by customer: `1.4.0` (node package), but the app uses esbuild/Vite polyfills.
jon: :eyes: can you paste the exact log lines and the request ids? also did they set any custom retry config?
laura: Logs (sanitized):
laura: ```
laura: 2026-03-12T14:21:07Z stream:start reqId=xyz-123
laura: 2026-03-12T14:21:10Z stream:error reqId=xyz-123 error=ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE
laura: 2026-03-12T14:21:10Z stream:retry scheduled reqId=xyz-123 retryId=xyz-123-r1
laura: 2026-03-12T14:21:11Z stream:start reqId=xyz-123-r1
laura: 2026-03-12T14:21:14Z stream:complete reqId=xyz-123-r1
laura: ```
laura: Customer also attached a HAR that shows two persistent EventSource connections overlapping.
alex: Interesting — two quick suspects: (1) the edge runtime's ReadableStream is being polyfilled/overridden by Vite or a dependency, causing the SDK to mis-detect streaming support and fallback/retry logic to misbehave. (2) The SDK's streaming retry window triggers because the runtime throws a premature close which is recoverable, but the retry creates a second active stream instead of cancelling the first.
jon: Can they reproduce with a plain deploy (no polyfills) or a simple node script (not edge)? if it only happens on edge, bundler polyfills are likely.
laura: They tried a node container and the stream doesn't abort there. Only on Vercel Edge and Cloudflare workers.
devex-bot: New support ticket created: SUP-4826 — Escalation: edge streaming abort + duplicate billing. Assigning to eng-runtime.
alex: Workarounds to try immediately:
alex: - Ensure globalThis.ReadableStream is the native implementation in the edge runtime. Vite's `readable-stream` polyfill can leak into builds — remove that polyfill or set `optimizeDeps.exclude` for the polyfill package.
alex: - Disable SDK automatic streaming retries in the client config: `new Redwood({ retry: { maxAttempts: 0 } })` so at least you avoid duplicate requests while we patch.
alex: - As a short-term bandaid, add server-side dedupe on reqId if duplicate `reqId` is seen within 5s to prevent double billing.
jon: Also ask the customer to set `REDWOOD_DEBUG=stream` in env to get the SDK debug logs (or run with `DEBUG=redwood:sdk`). We need full stack traces and the fetch signals.
laura: Customer says they can't easily remove Vite polyfills yet. They applied `maxAttempts: 0` and saw single request but still an abort (no retry). They want to know root cause and whether this will be charged once or twice.
alex: From logs it looks the retry did fire in the default config (so they would have been charged twice). With retries disabled they should only have one charge, but if the original stream started sending tokens before abort, customer could still see partial consumption. We'll investigate billing-side protections.
ops: added billing-runbook note: when duplicate request ids observed within 10s, hold charges and flag for manual review. tagging finance.
laura: Attaching reproduction repo link and har + SDK debug output (redacted) — https://github.com/customer/repro-edge-stream (private link)
jon: Quick debugging notes I asked them to run:
jon: 1) set `globalThis.ReadableStream = undefined` before importing the SDK (in a dev build) to force native detection
jon: 2) reproduce and capture network tab HAR
jon: 3) run with `new Redwood({ streamChunkTimeoutMs: 10000 })` to increase tolerances
alex: Found a local repro: Vite's `stream` polyfill wraps `getReader()` and emits a synchronous close when under backpressure in the edge bundling mode. Patch plan: we will ship a runtime check to prefer native `ReadableStream` shape and ignore certain polyfilled implementations. Patch target: v1.4.3 (hotfix). Workaround until then: pin to `@redwood/inference@1.3.8` or use `maxAttempts: 0`.
laura: Customer asked about timeline — can we push a hotfix to hosted API or do they need to change their code? they prefer a server-side mitigation.
alex: We can do a hosted-runtime defensive change to avoid automatic retrying on streams that indicate `ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE` from the edge origin within the first 2s. However that's risky; prefer pushing SDK hotfix so clients get consistent behavior. I'll schedule an emergency patch and follow up here with the release PR.
devex-bot: Patch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987 — v1.4.3 hotfix (stream detection + retry guard)
laura: Thanks. I've given the customer the `maxAttempts: 0` workaround and asked for logs after they test. Leaving this thread open until v1.4.3 confirmed.
jon: :thumbsup: keep me posted. If they still see duplicate billing after workaround we'll escalate to finance ops.
alex: TL;DR for running notes: remove polyfill OR pin older SDK OR disable retries. We'll release v1.4.3 with detection and guard in ~24-48h.
